note: Export side is factually confirmed: real customs export shipments with dates (19–26 Feb 2026), destinations (UAE/Jebel Ali, Nepal/Biratnagar, Sri Lanka/Colombo), HS 84281011 (passenger lifts) and B/L numbers (1045221, 1010944, 9885070, 9821895). Note the declared HS codes 842840 (escalators/moving walkways) and 843131 (parts of lifts/escalators) do appear in the data — e.g. import row 2026-02-27 from BEIJING ORIENT ELEVATOR, HS 84313100, BOL 7788824 — but the dominant actual export code is 84281011 (lifts), so the HS field should be corrected to the factual range 842810/843131. Role: manufacturer (own-brand "JOHNSON" lifts produced at Chennai/SIPCOT and exported to group entity Johnson Lifts Middle East Services LLC, Dubai). Source counter vs rows seen: 20571 claimed vs 5 rows visible on the free page — treat the counter as unverified aggregate, the 5 rows as the actual evidence. Domestic supply: no GST turnover, tender or contract record found in the sources read; status declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue: null (not public in sources read). No rejection grounds — legal entity exists and is actively trading.
